business_meaning: Unique savings account number for this account version.
inferred_rules: No nulls; uniqueness should be enforced per account version; primary business natural key for account-level joins; format/length <= 20 characters.

business_meaning: Identifier of the customer who owns the account.
documented_rules: One customer can hold several accounts.
inferred_rules: No nulls; referential integrity to customer/party dimension expected; format/length <= 20 characters.

business_meaning: Code representing the savings product type.
documented_rules: Allowed values: EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA.
inferred_rules: Value must be one of the allowed product codes; impacts conditional rules (e.g., AccountMaturityDate mandatory when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y).

business_meaning: Current lifecycle status of the account.
documented_rules: Allowed values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN.
inferred_rules: Value must be one of the allowed statuses; if AccountStatus = CLOSED then AccountCloseDate must be populated and Balance must equal 0.00; status transitions across SCD2 versions should be captured.

business_meaning: Three-letter ISO currency of the account.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null and equal to 'GBP'; length = 3; used for monetary interpretation of Balance and InterestRate.
Must be non-null; should be <= today; if AccountMaturityDate populated then AccountOpenDate < AccountMaturityDate; ValidFrom/ValidTo SCD2 ordering may be related.

When populated must be > AccountOpenDate; for non-term products may be NULL; should not be in the past prior to open date; if ProductCode = FIXED_1Y then non-null and typically >= AccountOpenDate + 1 year.

If populated must be >= AccountOpenDate; if AccountStatus = CLOSED then non-null and should be <= today; when populated, Balance must equal 0.00; SCD2 versioning may require ValidTo to align with close date.

business_meaning: Annual interest rate applied to the account (%).
inferred_rules: Must be non-null; expected >= 0.00; reasonable upper bound (e.g., < 100.00) should be enforced; decimal precision (5,2) must be respected; may vary by ProductCode.

Must be non-null; currency in GBP; may be >= 0.00 unless overdrafts allowed (not documented); when AccountStatus != CLOSED, Balance may be non-zero; should reconcile with daily FactAccountBalance and transaction running balances.

business_meaning: SCD2 start timestamp for this account version.
documented_rules: Curate keeps history using ValidFrom and ValidTo (9999-12-31 = current version).
inferred_rules: Non-null; used as SCD2 start; ValidFrom <= ValidTo; DateSK/LoadDate in facts derived from ValidFrom; ValidFrom should not be in future for historical rows; ordering across versions must be non-overlapping.

business_meaning: SCD2 end timestamp for this account version.
documented_rules: Curate keeps history using ValidFrom and ValidTo (9999-12-31 = current version).
inferred_rules: Non-null; 9999-12-31 indicates current version; ValidTo > ValidFrom; SCD2 ranges must not overlap for same natural key; exactly one version per natural key should have ValidTo = 9999-12-31.

business_meaning: ETL load timestamp when this row/version was loaded into Curate.
documented_rules: Load process: full load in DEV/TEST; incremental load in STAGE/PROD.
inferred_rules: Non-null; should be monotonic for incremental loads; used for load-time auditing; timestamp should be <= current system time; may be used to detect late-arriving data.
